provenance.source: owner screen recording 'Recording 2026-08-27 at 23.38.04.mp4' (70 s, 60 fps, 1640x1408, HEVC) of the previous dashboard build's Shadow view while playing; the recording itself is private and NOT committed
provenance.extraction: the Shadow preview region (972x568 px, detected per frame from the dashboard chrome) was cropped from every 12th recording frame (5 fps) and subsampled per sequence as recorded in sample_period_s; frames were stored as WebP q86 with the chat strip, bottom HUD and currency readout pixelated
provenance.canonical_mapping: the previous build letterboxed the 1800x1052 pt client into 1280x720; a stored frame maps into canonical space by uniform scale 1232/972 with a 24 px black bar on each side (prospector_engine.corpus.canonicalize)
provenance.labels: bounding boxes from an independent yellow-mask reference with temporal continuity; headings from a rotation/squash fit of the measured arrow polygon (tests/arrow_fixtures.py) with the 180-degree ambiguity resolved by reviewer-read anchors; every frame was checked on verification sheets and the frames the reviewer could not read are marked unknown
provenance.label_error_budget: heading labels are believed good to about +-12 degrees; a p95 angular target of 10 degrees cannot be certified from this corpus
provenance.known_biases: frames marked overlay_contact carry the previous build's jade detection outline and gold markers drawn on the arrow, which favourably separates it from same-colour sand; the preview was downscaled (0.54x) then upscaled, so detail is softer than a live capture; WebP compression adds slight ringing
provenance.status: PENDING as production evidence: one session, one map, one machine, one lighting pass per stratum, and no separately held-out session
